{{Quote|Lord Vader! It's the final Rebel attack you predicted! But&hellip;it's only one small ship! They're ''mad!''"<br />"Or hoping to appear so! Maintain full shields, Admiral!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the Imperial admiral|<ref name="Doom Mission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''admiral''' served aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] maiden voyage. He served aboard the Super Star Destroyer's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[power gem]] [[Skirmish in the Feswe Corridor|attack]] on the ''Executor'' in the [[Feswe Corridor]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character bears a striking resemblance to Admiral [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Indeed, the ''[[Classic Star Wars]]'' run may have intended this character to be Ozzel, although the comic does not address him by anything more specific than "Admiral." However, the [[2007]] novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']] has established that Ozzel does not receive his assignment to the ''Executor'' until after the ''Classic Star Wars'' comic strip ''[[Doom Mission]]'' in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|timeline]], and no further connection beside visual similarity links these two characters in any way.

This character serves as an admiral aboard the ''Executor'' concurrently alongside another [[Unidentified Imperial admiral (Griff's successor)|admiral]] during the Super Star Destroyer's maiden voyage, although the admiral referenced in this article only appears fleetingly, while the other admiral acts as the primary commander of the ''Executor''.
